summary: Full backend and frontend testing of enhanced AI Writing Assistant (iteration 2). All 12 new backend tests passed (100%). Frontend: all new features working - Quick Templates (4), Personalization Panel, Variations (3 cards), Why Good Fit, Evaluation scores, Regenerate, Copy to clipboard. One minor issue: detected_mode badge shows for non-auto modes (email mode shows 'JOB_APPLICATION MODE' from Claude's JSON response).

minor.issue: When mode='email', Claude sometimes returns non-null detected_mode (e.g. 'job_application') instead of null. The prompt says 'null if not auto' but Claude interprets freely. This causes the auto-detected badge to show on email mode results. Fix: filter detected_mode in backend to only return it when req.mode == 'auto'.

issues: Dark theme looks clean, well-spaced, good contrast. No layout issues observed.

action_items: Optional fix: In server.py /api/generate, set detected_mode=None when req.mode != 'auto' to prevent spurious auto-detected badge on non-auto mode results.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: detected_mode should be forced to None for non-auto modes in the response (line ~228). Currently uses data.get('detected_mode') directly which lets Claude return it for email mode too.
server.py: File is 258 lines - acceptable size, no split needed.
All new features (auto-mode, variations, why_good_fit, evaluation, personalization) correctly implemented and integrated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend + frontend features working. 12/12 backend tests pass. Auto-mode grammar detection, email detection, 3 variations, why_good_fit, evaluation scores, personalization panel, quick templates all verified working. Only known minor issue: detected_mode badge shows for non-auto modes (low priority).
rca_of_issue: detected_mode badge shows for email mode: The build_prompt schema instruction says '<mode if auto, else null>' but Claude still returns a value (e.g. 'job_application') for non-auto modes. Fix in server.py: change line ~228 to `detected_mode=data.get('detected_mode') if req.mode == 'auto' else None`.
